name: volt-api
description: Volt API is a production-ready Go backend boilerplate for building modular services — a schema-first GraphQL API via gqlgen, Ent ORM with typed migrations, NATS JetStream events, type-safe Go configuration (defaults compiled in, env-overridable), OpenTelemetry tracing and structured logging, a Cobra CLI, and cron workers, all wired end-to-end under a go.work monorepo.

positioning.category: Go backend boilerplate / service starter kit
positioning.audience: Solo developers and teams building full-stack Go backend services
positioning.wedge: GraphQL, ORM, events, config, observability, CLI, and cron are wired end-to-end under one go.work monorepo — so you start on business logic in minutes, not plumbing.
differentiators: Schema-first GraphQL via gqlgen with Ent types auto-mapped — edit the .graphqls, regenerate resolvers
Ent ORM with a shared BaseMixin, typed migrations, and pgvector support
Type-safe Go configuration — one file is the schema, defaults and validation; no raw os.Getenv in app code
Event-driven NATS JetStream handlers wired into the app bootstrap lifecycle
OpenTelemetry tracing + structured Zap logging with trace correlation, out of the box
go.work monorepo with separate API, cron, and CLI binaries and a shared lace/ utility library
